\section{Introduction}
\IEEEPARstart{E}{dge} inference with KV cache migration~\cite{zhang2024kv} can reduce tail latency
for multi-tenant serving. We study the trade-off between migration cost and reliability.

\begin{equation}
L = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \lambda_i \tau_i + \mu \sigma^{2} \label{eq:latency}
\end{equation}

As shown in Equation~\eqref{eq:latency} and Figure~\ref{fig:arch}, the architecture is
organised into three tiers. The KV cache is replicated across tiers to survive node failure.
